source: USDA ERS Rural-Urban Commuting Area codes, tract level.
why_pinned: Two RUCA files on this machine share an identical row count of 85,528 with DIFFERENT hashes, and the wrong one passed every row-count check. Only the hash distinguishes them. The vintage must also match the tract vintage or the rurality join silently drops tracts.
nature: HISTORICAL FROZEN INPUTS supporting v0.2.0. Do not regenerate: a newer RUCA release is a different classification vintage, not a correction.
